import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
report = {
    'recorded_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'platform': platform.platform(),
    'cpu': next(line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('model name')),
    'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['target/local-tools/fastdiff-rustup/toolchains/1.90.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rustc', '--version'], text=True).strip(),
    'profile': 'rustc --edition=2024 -O; System allocator, separate cfg memory_measurement build',
    'source_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ['harness.rs', 'merge_functions.rs']},
    'method': 'Exact old/current merge functions and model struct layouts; 32-byte synthetic raw paths; disjoint: n total records split across both inputs, overlap: n working + n committed for n destinations; input cloning and output validation/drop excluded from timer; one warmup and five samples per variant; byte-for-byte output equality and first-occurrence order assertions.',
    'memory_method': 'Separate fresh process per variant; System global allocator tracks requested live heap bytes including inputs and output; excludes allocator bookkeeping, reserved arenas, stack and RSS; peak includes transient vector/hash-map reallocation requested sizes, not System allocator internal copies. Memory-only cases add 128-byte paths. Deltas subtract each process input_live baseline to remove argv/runtime size differences; after-merge delta compares net live change after consuming inputs, not standalone output size.',
    'cases': [],
}
for length in [32, 128]:
    for n in ([1000, 10000, 50000] if length == 32 else [50000]):
        for workload in ['disjoint', 'overlap']:
            case = {'distinct_paths': n, 'path_bytes': length, 'workload': workload, 'variants': {}}
            for variant in ['old', 'indexed']:
                row = {}
                if length == 32:
                    output = subprocess.check_output([str(root / 'timing'), str(n), str(length), workload, variant], text=True)
                    row['samples_ms'] = [json.loads(line)['ns'] / 1_000_000 for line in output.splitlines()]
                    row['median_ms'] = statistics.median(row['samples_ms'])
                row['heap'] = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root / 'memory'), str(n), str(length), workload, variant], text=True))
                case['variants'][variant] = row
            old, indexed = (case['variants'][v] for v in ['old', 'indexed'])
            if length == 32:
                case['median_speedup'] = old['median_ms'] / indexed['median_ms']
            case['added_peak_live_bytes'] = indexed['heap']['peak_above_input_bytes'] - old['heap']['peak_above_input_bytes']
            case['after_merge_live_difference_bytes'] = (indexed['heap']['after_merge_live_bytes'] - indexed['heap']['input_live_bytes']) - (old['heap']['after_merge_live_bytes'] - old['heap']['input_live_bytes'])
            report['cases'].append(case)
            (root / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != 'variants'}), flush=True)
print('Report saved:', root / 'report.json', flush=True)
